premise: Butterfly looks for something sweet and tastes by landing: on Deer's head (grassy), on Mushroom's cap (mossy), at last on Flower — sweet! — because butterflies taste with their feet.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three tries (folk), turned: too grassy, too mossy, just right — and Deer, trying it her way, goes back to his own.
lesson: Everyone has their own way of finding what they like.

en-US.title: Butterfly Tastes with Her Feet
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} Butterfly was looking for something sweet. [curious] How does a butterfly know if a thing is sweet? Easy. She lands on it! {deer:enter} Deer was in the meadow nearby, {deer:live graze} nibbling the grass. {butterfly:go on deer} Down {sfx:flutter} fluttered Butterfly, right onto his head. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip went her feet. {butterfly:face sad} "Hmm. Grassy. Not sweet." Up popped a red {mushroom:enter} mushroom. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Butterfly landed on her cap. Tip, tip. "Hmm. Mossy. Not sweet." {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] "That tickles!" said Mushroom. And there, opening up, was a yellow {flower:enter} flower. {butterfly:go on flower} Butterfly landed right in the middle. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} "SWEET!" {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} "How do you know?" asked Deer. [whispers] "I tasted it," said Butterfly, "with my feet." {deer:face surprised} So Deer {deer:live tap-hoof} tapped the grass with his hoof. Tip, tip. Nothing at all. {deer:face happy} So he {deer:live graze} nibbled it the usual way. "Mmm," he said. "Grassy. Just how I like it." {butterfly:live rest hold} And Butterfly folded her wings on Flower, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} sweet as can be.

es-ES.title: Las patitas de Mariposa
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} Mariposa andaba buscando algo dulce. [curious] ¿Y cómo sabe una mariposa si algo es dulce? Muy fácil: ¡se posa encima! {deer:enter} Ciervo estaba allí cerca, en el prado, {deer:live graze} mordisqueando hierba. {butterfly:go on deer} Mariposa bajó {sfx:flutter} revoloteando y se le posó en la cabeza. {deer:face surprised} Tip, tip, hicieron sus patitas. {butterfly:face sad} —Mmm. Sabe a hierba. No es dulce. Asomó una {mushroom:enter} seta roja. {butterfly:go on mushroom} Mariposa se posó en su sombrero. Tip, tip. —Mmm. Sabe a musgo. Tampoco. {mushroom:live laugh} [giggles] —¡Ay, qué cosquillas! —dijo Seta. Y allí, abriéndose despacito, había una {flower:enter} flor amarilla. {butterfly:go on flower} Mariposa se posó justo en el centro. Tip, tip… {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} [excited] {sfx:sip} —¡DULCE! {deer:face normal} {deer:pulse} —¿Y tú cómo lo sabes? —preguntó Ciervo. [whispers] —Porque lo he probado —dijo Mariposa—. Con las patitas. {deer:face surprised} Así que Ciervo {deer:live tap-hoof} tocó la hierba con la pezuña. Tip, tip. Nada de nada. {deer:face happy} Y la {deer:live graze} mordisqueó como siempre. —Mmm —dijo—. Sabe a hierba. Como a mí me gusta. {butterfly:live rest hold} Y Mariposa plegó las alas sobre Flor, {flower:face happy} {flower:hearts} dulce, dulcísima.
